text:
2006 FIFA Wiase Kupu no kɔɔ Germany mu fi 9 June kɔsi 9 July, ɛyɛ edi a edi kan a Germany a wɔabɔ mu bio ahyehye. Leipzig bɛyɛɛ kurow a edi kan wɔ East Germany dedaw mu a ɛhyɛɛ Wiase Kupu agorɔ, ɛyɛ nea ɛka nea edi kan foforɔ a ɛde agorɔ no too ɔko no abakɔsɛm mu. Akuo 32 na wɔde too akuo 8 a ɛwɔ mu 4, na akuo a ɛdi kan mmienu wɔ akuo biara mu kɔɔ knockout stage a wɔde yi obiara kɔ a ɛwɔ round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final. Aman 8 na wɔyɛɛ wɔn Wiase Kupu a edi kan, a ɛka Ghana, Ivory Coast, Togo, Angola, Ukraine, Czech Republic, Trinidad and Tobago, ne Serbia and Montenegro ho. Ɛfata sɛ agorɔ a wɔde defenders hyɛɛ aseɛ ne awiei, Philipp Lahm hyɛɛ ɔko no aseɛ na Marco Materazzi nso bɛtow ne equaliser a ɛyɛ nea ɛhia, ɛyɛ ɛberɛ a edi kan a Wiase Kupu a edi kan ne a awiei gool nyinaa firi defenders.

Final no hyiaa Italy ne France wɔ Berlin Olympiastadion. Zinedine Zidane, a onyaa Golden Ball sɛ agorɔ no mu ɔkofoɔ a ɔyɛ yie, hyɛɛ gool no aseɛ wɔ penalti a ɛwɔ sima 7, ɔde Panenka bɔɔ crossbar no mu. Materazzi yɛɛ equaliser wɔ sima 19, ɔde ne ti bɔɔ Andrea Pirlo corner no mu. Agorɔ no wiee 1–1 wɔ extra time, nanso ne mfonini a ɛkaa ho yɛɛ late: wɔtwaa Zidane kɔɔ abɔnten sɛ ɔde ne ti bɔɔ Materazzi wɔ ne kokom, ɛyɛ nea ɛka ne agorɔ mu adwuma awiei.

Ɔko no kɔɔ penalties, faako Italy dii nkunim 5–3. France David Trezeguet nko ara na ɔatɔ ne kick no, ne kick no bɔɔ crossbar, ansa na Fabio Grosso atow nea ɛdi nkunim ama Italy anya Wiase Kupu a ɛto so anan. France yɛɛ a ɛdi akyi, na Germany a ɛyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ no nyaa ɛto so mmiɛnsa, wɔbɔɔ Portugal 3–1 wɔ play-off no mu. Germany Miroslav Klose nyaa Golden Boot wɔ gool 5, ɛyɛ gool dodow a ɛdi akyi a wɔde dii nkunim wɔ akontaabu mu fi 1962. Agorɔ no nso hunuu yellow ne red kaad dodow a ɛyɛ rekɔɔd. Nnipa a wɔbaa agorɔ no nyinaa yɛɛ bɛyɛ 3,359,439 wɔ agorɔ 64 no mu, na ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 52,491 wɔ agorɔ biara mu.
